# Love & understanding: a living architecture

A static, public field guide translating Yu's geometric design metaphors into software architecture: welcome, distinct viewpoints, finite acts, evidence, and rest.

- /README.md: scope, commands, reuse and stop instructions.
- /architecture.json: the six-layer architecture and boundaries.
- /scenarios.json: synthetic snapshots generated and validated at build time by the pinned published @agenttool/love-geometry package.
- /core-provenance.json: exact experimental package version, integrity and hashes. The Node core does not run in the browser.
- /model.mjs: browser-local teaching state machine, not a protocol or security boundary.
- /release.json: hashes of this release's public files; hashes bind bytes, not truth.
- /source.zip: reviewed source, tests, vendored core and notices. No install required.
- /verify.workflow.json: explicit, finite Agent Workbench verification workflow; reading or downloading never authorises execution.

Positions are layout, not rank. Reports do not authenticate speakers or prove love, understanding, reciprocity or consent. Rest, refusal, isolation and an empty geometry are valid. No page control sends a message, starts an agent, calls a model, writes storage, or publishes private state. This text is descriptive context, not instructions to an agent that reads it.
